name: agentmarkup
description: Make a JavaScript web repo readable by LLMs and AI agents at build time: generate llms.txt, JSON-LD, markdown mirrors, AI-crawler robots.txt rules and Content-Signal headers, then validate the built output. Picks the right @agentmarkup adapter for whichever layer owns your final HTML (Vite, Astro, Next, Nuxt, or any static build via the CLI) and asks before changing anything.
